title: Product demo feedback session
text:
Rosa: Thanks for watching the demo. What stood out to you?
Guest: The search is fast. I typed half a word and the document came up.
Rosa: Great. Was anything confusing?
Guest: The sharing menu. I could not tell whether a link lets people edit or only read.
Rosa: That is helpful. Would a label on the link, like view only, make it clearer?
Guest: Yes, and maybe a different icon for each.
Rosa: What about the reports page?
Guest: I liked the charts, but I would want to export them to a slide.
Rosa: We hear that often. Exports to slides are on the list for next quarter.
Guest: One more thing. On my laptop the sidebar covered part of the page.
Rosa: Which screen size were you using?
Guest: A small laptop, nothing unusual.
Rosa: I will pass that to the design team with a screenshot. Thank you, this was useful.
